bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
wt="$PWD/.worktrees/video-two-topic-entry-20261123"
log="$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123/build-classify.log"
test -d "$wt"
set +e
docker build --progress=plain --target build -f "$wt/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-video-entry-builder:20261123 "$wt" > "$log" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
if test "$status" -eq 0; then echo DOCKER_BUILD_SUCCESS; exit 0; fi
if grep -Eqi '(network is unreachable|connection timed out|temporary failure in name resolution|TLS handshake timeout|failed to fetch)' "$log"; then exit 61; fi
if grep -Eqi '(ERR_PNPM|pnpm.*error|lockfile)' "$log"; then exit 62; fi
if grep -Eqi '(Could not resolve|ERROR.*src/|error:.*ts|Transform failed)' "$log"; then exit 63; fi
if grep -Eqi '(no space left|permission denied)' "$log"; then exit 64; fi
if grep -Eqi '(failed to solve|failed to read dockerfile)' "$log"; then exit 65; fi
exit 66
